summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase Π+3.1 image regression fixes (iteration 12 follow-up). All 3 previously failing checks now pass end-to-end against the deployed preview URL. New live_reporting tile on /for-advertisers is a real with naturalWidth=1024. StationTile primitive now emits an > so Party Mix (+ 3 other featured stations) all report naturalWidth>0 on the logged-in Home (/). Home Discover strip has actual children (home-discover-img-) with naturalWidth=1024 for every tile — no CSS-only backgrounds remain. Zero image 404s across landing, /for-business, /for-advertisers, and / (demo user).
critical_code_review_comments: StationTile onError fallback path (CSS-gradient div) is only reachable if the fails to load — good. But the img element is rendered even when artwork is null and its src becomes empty string, which will trigger a NS_ERROR_DOM_INVALID_URI in some engines; consider guarding with a conditional render.

Home.jsx Discover strip still keeps the black-gradient scrim as a sibling of the ; that's intentional overlay for the label text but overlaps the img data-testid selection — luckily the img is the first child so query works. Fine as-is.
18 marketing_assets rows and 6+ landing_image files continue to grow — no dedupe/tidy job yet; not urgent.

party_dubai_302_note: party_dubai.webp continues to return HTTP 302 (Tigris presigned URL fallback). Playwright follows the redirect and the final image paints with naturalWidth=1024. Counted as pass per acceptance criteria (200 or 302→200 both acceptable).
